Candle flames appear solid/plastic rather than translucent fire (severity 2 texture anomaly). While the overall scene composition is coherent and lighting consistent, these anatomical and material defects indicate generative instability. The tusk fusion is particularly problematic as it violates basic elephant anatomy taxonomy checkpoints.
